headwords: râu ông nọ cắm cằm bà kia

flags.why: The example defines radon instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Họ đo nồng độ rađon trong nhà. = They measured the radon concentration in the house.

flags.why: The example describes what rhenium is instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Phòng thí nghiệm vừa nhận một mẫu reni. = The laboratory has just received a sample of rhenium.

flags.why: The example defines roentgenium instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Nhóm nghiên cứu đang tìm hiểu tính chất của roentgeni. = The research team is investigating the properties of roentgenium.

flags.why: The example explains what rhodium is and what it is used for instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Chiếc nhẫn này được mạ rođi. = This ring is plated with rhodium.

flags.why: “Ru hời” means to lull someone by singing, whereas “lullaby” names the song, as confirmed by this [dictionary entry](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ru%20h%E1%BB%9Di).
flags.fix: verb | to sing lullabies; to lull someone to sleep by singing

flags.why: The example defines rubidium instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Họ đang nghiên cứu tính chất của rubiđi. = They are studying the properties of rubidium.

flags.why: The example defines ruthenium instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Mẫu này có chứa ruteni. = This sample contains ruthenium.
